title: PDU EAP message reliable transport procedure accepted by the UE

entities.name: PDU EAP message reliable transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE creates and sends a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message containing EAP-response or received EAP message from 5G ProSe remote UE.

entities.name: PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE containing EAP message and optionally remote UE handling information.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Information element containing EAP-response message or received EAP message from 5G ProSe remote UE.

entities.name: Remote UE handling information
entities.description: Information element containing remote user identity when EAP message is received from 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE.

entities.name: NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to transport PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message and PDU session ID.

entities.name: T3590
entities.description: Timer stopped by SMF upon receipt of PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.

entities.name: EAP message from 5G ProSe remote UE
entities.description: Condition where EAP message is received from 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE as defined in TS 24.554.

entities.name: SMF handles EAP message
entities.description: SMF provides EAP message to DN or handles it locally after stopping timer T3590.

relations.description: Procedure includes creating and sending PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.
Message contains EAP message information element.
Message contains remote UE handling information element when condition is met.
Remote UE handling IE inclusion is guarded by condition of EAP message from 5G ProSe remote UE.
Procedure uses NAS transport procedure to send message and PDU session ID.
Receipt of message stops timer T3590 at SMF.
Receipt of message establishes that SMF handles EAP message.
